newsitem.title: USA: Green Tree files shelf for $3 bln debt.
newsitem.headline: Green Tree files shelf for $3 bln debt.

text.p: Green Tree Financial Corp said Friday it filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $3 billion in manufactured housing contract pass-through certificates.
When combined with a previous registration, Green Tree will have a total offering of up to $5.3 billion of the securities available for sale.
The certificates represent interests in manufactured housing installment loan agreements, the filing said. The cerfiticates will be sold in series.
No underwriters were named in the registration.
Net proceeds will be use for general corporate purposes, the company said.

Through its various divisions, the St. Paul, Minn.,-based company purchases, pools, sells and services retail conditional sales contracts for manufactured housing and retail installment sales for home improvements, among others.
